Austin, TX · Hair and makeup artists

Jessica Roop Beauty & Boudoir

$600 package

Austin bridal hair and makeup team offering preview sessions in studio and day-of service on location. Weekend dates have a service minimum described on the bridal page.

The Bombshell Bride package starts at $600 and includes a hair and makeup preview, day-of hair and makeup, a touch-up kit, lashes, and extension placement if the client brings extensions. Hair-only and makeup-only bridal packages each start at $400. Bridesmaid hair or makeup is $120, and flower-girl services start at $75. Popular Friday–Sunday dates require a 10-service minimum. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
